name: qopy-cloudflare-sync
description: A private, end-to-end encrypted Cloudflare sync service for Qopy.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Create or select the private D1 database used by Qopy Sync.

ASSETS.description: Create or select the private R2 bucket used for encrypted clipboard images.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long random one-time token. Enter the same value in Qopy during first-time setup.
